title: Convert international domain labels into caller buffers
goal: Convert Unicode and ASCII domain labels into caller-owned spans when capacity, invalid-input handling and the deployment globalization policy are explicit.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Primary net11.0 consumer; actual RC2 proof is distinct from GA verification.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build against the net11.0 references; exact SDK pins identify reproduction, not a universal exact-SDK requirement.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical C#15 current sample mode; comparison uses C#14. No preview language switch is needed.

platforms: Windows x64, non-invariant system ICU (measured72.1.0.4); configure System.Globalization.Invariant=false and System.Globalization.UseNls=false. NLS/invariant/other-platform or other-data execution is unverified.
prerequisites: SDK console/library project with Nullable and ImplicitUsings enabled; include each complete canonical helper as a separate .cs file.
Use RuntimeHostConfigurationOption items for System.Globalization.Invariant=false and System.Globalization.UseNls=false; record actual system ICU/data. No DNS/network service.
constraints: Windows x64, non-invariant system ICU (measured72.1.0.4); configure System.Globalization.Invariant=false and System.Globalization.UseNls=false. NLS/invariant/other-platform or other-data execution is unverified.

Non-overlapping spans; false/zero for insufficient capacity, ArgumentException for invalid input. Ignore destination on failure. IDNA conversion is not domain authorization or spoofing prevention; AllowUnassigned=true does not guarantee acceptance.
